headline_stat.name: % POST ripples with significant replay (cell-ID shuffle p<0.05)

justification.dataset: 000044 Achilles CA1 linear-track session is the canonical dataset for sharp-wave ripples, place fields, and replay.
justification.handling: Real LFP and spikes streamed via remfile with correct PRE/POST/Maze epochs, Non-REM state masking, cell-type-based unit selection, and data-driven ripple channel choice.
justification.analysis: Standard ripple detection, Skaggs spatial information with a circular time-shift null, and Bayesian replay decoding validated by two independent shuffles plus a PRE/POST experience-dependence control.
justification.correctness: Every headline number reproduces exactly from the committed log, but the README mislabels the ripple rate as 0.58 per min when it is 0.58 per second (34.8 per min), a minor internal inconsistency.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes and plainly show the phenomenon; example replay events are ranked by |wc|, which is the effect itself, and are backed by honest population summaries.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to the evidence and nothing is misrepresented, but the write-up names no specific limitations (single session, template asymmetry), placing a genuinely clean result at 3 rather than 4.
